note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and B/L number exist across at least two distinct company-name variants (UNITED MUD-CHEM PRIVATE LIMITED and UNITED MUD-CHEM PVT. LTD.), spanning 2019-2026 and destinations UAE, Nigeria, Netherlands, Vietnam, Australia. Declared HS set (281122;382410;382499;390390) is only partially matched by observed records: HS 38249900 appears in the Nigeria shipment, but observed rows also carry 35051090, 27149010, 34029099 and 380036, which are outside the declared set. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the HS code should be corrected to the factual observed codes and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, Google returned HTTP 429, DuckDuckGo/searx backend was unreachable ('Connection refused'), and Bing returned only irrelevant United Airlines results. Therefore domestic_status is recorded as unknown with null evidence rather than inferred from the company's own website or catalogue, which per rule 5 would only amount to 'declared, not confirmed'. Revenue and export volume figures are null: ImportKey's free view exposes shipment counts (1113 records) but no monetary values, and no financial statements were retrievable. No CIN, PAN or GSTIN was confirmed from a primary registry, so those fields are left null rather than guessed.
